facts: **Latitude** measures degrees north or south from the **Equator** ($0^{\circ}$), ranging from $90^{\circ}\text{S}$ to $90^{\circ}\text{N}$.
**Longitude** measures degrees east or west from the **Prime Meridian** ($0^{\circ}$), ranging from $180^{\circ}\text{W}$ to $180^{\circ}\text{E}$.
Coordinates are written as $(\text{latitude}, \text{longitude})$, such as $(30^{\circ}\text{N}, 45^{\circ}\text{E})$.
The **Equator** has latitude $0^{\circ}$, and the **Prime Meridian** has longitude $0^{\circ}$.
In digital coordinates, negative values represent south latitudes or west longitudes, such as $-33.8^{\circ} = 33.8^{\circ}\text{S}$.

foundation.question_text:
City $X$ has coordinates $(35^{\circ}\text{S}, 140^{\circ}\text{E})$ and City $Y$ has coordinates $(35^{\circ}\text{S}, 175^{\circ}\text{E})$.
Do these two cities share the same parallel of latitude or the same meridian of longitude?
foundation.solution_text:
$\text{Latitude of } X = 35^{\circ}\text{S}$
$\text{Latitude of } Y = 35^{\circ}\text{S}$
$\text{Longitude of } X = 140^{\circ}\text{E}$
$\text{Longitude of } Y = 175^{\circ}\text{E}$
Both cities have a latitude of $35^{\circ}\text{S}$, so they share the same parallel of latitude.

$\text{Coordinates of } K = (50^{\circ}\text{N}, 30^{\circ}\text{E})$

$\text{Coordinates of } M = (25^{\circ}\text{S}, 60^{\circ}\text{W})$

Points lying on the same horizontal line share the same latitude.

Points $L$ and $M$ share the same parallel of latitude.

mastery.question_text: Find the coordinates of the point $35^{\circ}$ due east of $(22^{\circ}\text{N}, 160^{\circ}\text{E})$.
mastery.solution_text:
The latitude stays $22^{\circ}\text{N}$.
From $160^{\circ}\text{E}$, move $180^{\circ}-160^{\circ}=20^{\circ}$ east to the $180^{\circ}$ meridian.
There are $35^{\circ}-20^{\circ}=15^{\circ}$ left to move east, giving longitude $180^{\circ}-15^{\circ}=165^{\circ}\text{W}$.
The coordinates are $(22^{\circ}\text{N}, 165^{\circ}\text{W})$.

mastery.question_text: Find the coordinates of the point $45^{\circ}$ due west of $(28^{\circ}\text{S}, 155^{\circ}\text{W})$.
mastery.solution_text:
The latitude stays $28^{\circ}\text{S}$.
From $155^{\circ}\text{W}$, move $180^{\circ}-155^{\circ}=25^{\circ}$ west to the $180^{\circ}$ meridian.
There are $45^{\circ}-25^{\circ}=20^{\circ}$ left to move west, giving longitude $180^{\circ}-20^{\circ}=160^{\circ}\text{E}$.
The coordinates are $(28^{\circ}\text{S}, 160^{\circ}\text{E})$.

mastery.question_text: A town is at latitude $38^{\circ}\text{N}$. What is the latitude of a second town that is $65^{\circ}$ due south of it?
mastery.solution_text:
Move $38^{\circ}$ south to reach the Equator.
There are $65^{\circ}-38^{\circ}=27^{\circ}$ left to move south.
The second town is at latitude $27^{\circ}\text{S}$.
